meta.channelLabel: CHILI LAB Japan / Headphones, Down Low
meta.setIdentity: CHILI LAB urban story episode: low spoken or sing-rap verses, melodic hooks, close mature vocals, recurring city details and controlled signature moments. Common DNA stays stronger than genre novelty.
meta.crossSetDifferentiation: Unlike 012, avoid repeated Rhodes-led alt-R&B and identical low-mid vocal treatment; unlike 013 v4, do not turn the episode into a 15-genre sampler. Use seven coherent genre families with micro-variation.
meta.genrePolicy: Seven families only: chill rap/jazz-hop, neo-soul/lo-fi soul, alt-R&B/tape-soul, garage/2-step, acoustic soul-hop/bossa-jazz, microhouse/dub, broken-beat/jazz-soul. Chill Rap and Urban Soul remain the center of gravity.
meta.instrumentPolicy: Rotate one foreground color per track while reusing a restrained common palette: Wurlitzer, upright piano, nylon or baritone guitar, Hammond, vibraphone, marimba, muted trumpet, flute, cello, fretless or upright bass, dub bass, tape texture.
meta.rhythmPolicy: Rap pocket first: broken, swung, loose boom-bap, 2-step, bossa, microhouse, dub and brushes. Avoid three consecutive tracks with the same kick/snare grammar.
meta.vocalPolicy: Close mature vocals with at least three phonation axes. Rap tracks use behind-the-beat narrative delivery; mixed tracks use sing-rap verses plus a melodic hook; song tracks remain intimate and compact.
meta.lyricPolicy: Scene first, emotion second. Reduce repetitive hand/shoulder/eyes/smile devices. Use rain, shutters, stairs, gate latch, crowd noise, arcade light, video frames, bench shadows, bus board and windshield as emotional proxies.
meta.rapRatioPolicy: 5 rap-centered, 7 mixed, 3 song-centered. Adjacent tracks do not repeat the same ratio.
meta.killingPointPolicy: Every track has one 8-15 second Signature Moment. Strength distribution: nine tracks 5-6/10, three tracks 7/10, three anchor tracks 9/10. Anchors are 2, 9 and 14 and are memorable through arrangement interruption, hook and instrument/vocal response rather than loudness.
meta.energyArc: 1-5 close and conversational, 6-10 more mobile, 11-15 nocturnal and reflective. Loudness stays low-to-mid throughout.

songs.title: Under the Awning
songs.seasonMoment: late-October drizzle in a narrow alley
songs.listenerSituation: ducking under a shop awning together while the street keeps moving around us
songs.genreText: CHILI LAB chill rap with trip-hop shading
songs.stylePrompt: CHILI LAB chill rap / trip-hop soul, 78 BPM; loose broken kick and rim, Wurlitzer, baritone guitar, restrained bass, faint rain texture. Smoky female contralto, dark low chest, 74% tone / 26% air, behind-the-beat spoken rap with short melodic hook. Signature moment: one-bar drum thinning before the title, then a descending three-note guitar answer. No volume lift.
songs.excludePrompt: glossy chill house, dominant Rhodes, trap hats, bright pop chorus, falsetto climax, hard snare, giant stack, artist imitation, copied melody
songs.lyrics:
[Intro - 4 bars instrumental]
[Verse 1 - 16 bars, low spoken rap]
Half a block in, weather changes sides,
green awning, two bicycles, delivery lights.
You read the menu taped inside the glass,
I read the rain line running down the curb.
Four doors from the station, nowhere to rush,
a scooter splits the puddle, then it's quiet.
I had a sentence ready all last week,
now it sounds too polished for this street.
So I start with something smaller instead,
that bakery closed, that sign got changed.
You answer like we have all night to waste,
and maybe that's the answer I needed first.

[Pre-Hook - 4 bars]
The rain gets loud enough to cover the gaps,
I let one honest line come through.

[Hook - 8 bars, melodic]
Wait Out the Rain,
we don't need another place to go.
Let the traffic finish what it's saying,
Wait Out the Rain.

[Verse 2 - 16 bars, low spoken rap]
Steam leaves the noodle shop next door,
a cardboard box goes soft along one edge.
You tell me what you almost texted Tuesday,
I tell you why I stared and didn't send.
No grand reveal, no perfect timing,
just water ticking from the striped canvas.
The street keeps moving without asking us,
and for once I don't mind staying still.

[Instrumental Break - 8 bars]
[Final Hook - 12 bars]
Wait Out the Rain,
this time the title lands a little later.
Same street, same weather, less to hide,
Wait Out the Rain.

Gate light on, bus already gone,
thirty steps and the route should end.
You check the weather, I check the time,

Laundry sign buzzing over the lane,
closed bakery chairs turned upside down.
I say the cold is getting worse from here,
you say then maybe we should keep moving.

[Pre-Hook - 8 bars]
No speech, no plan, just the crossing light,
one direction home, one direction longer.

[Signature Pause - 1 beat]
[Hook - 12 bars, melodic]
One More Block,
just until the next light changes.
One More Block,

[Verse 2 - 16 bars, sing-rap]
Cat under a van, steam from a vent,
old poster curling off a brick wall.
We pass the gate like it belongs to someone else,
and suddenly the street feels new again.
You tell me one story I haven't heard,
I give you one I usually edit out.
Nothing dramatic, nothing solved,
just another corner arriving too soon.

[Instrumental Break - 12 bars]
[Final Hook - 16 bars]
One More Block,
[Female low response: one more]

One More Block,
and this time the bass waits for the word.
